newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel steady in thin trade, demand slack.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel steady in thin trade, demand slack.

text.p: NWE jet fuel premiums were notionally unchanged in slow post-holiday trade on Friday, traders said.
"It's extremely quiet. I see very few offers and not so much buying," one trader said.
Benchmark Jan IPE gas oil futures at 1632 GMT were trading at $4.25 a tonne higher at $227.75 a tonne on bearish U.S. stocks data.
Cargo premiums were Jan IPE +$29/30, steady to around $1 higher, with traders reported scattered inquiries. Barges were around Jan IPE +$26, unchanged.
